facts.text: 11 OCT 2026 12:33PM by PIB Delhi Six-year plan to make India self-reliant in pulses by 2030-31 India is the world's largest producer of pulses, a globally important, protein-rich food crop.
Recognising this importance, the government launched the 'Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses' on October 11, 2025.

As the nation observes the first anniversary of the Mission’s launch on October 11, this landmark initiative continues its momentum, backed by a financial allocation of ₹11,440 crore spanning 2025–26 to 2030–31.
Under the Mission, by 2030-31, production is expected to reach nearly 350 lakh tonnes , with yield rising to 1,130 kg per hectare .
